name: code2zero-default-factors
description: Default environmental assumptions for Code2Zero — AI Footprint Inspector.

methodology.tokens: Estimated via character heuristic: Math.ceil(chars / charsPerToken), default 4 chars per token.
methodology.carbon_gco2e: electricity_wh * co2PerWh (grams CO2e per watt-hour, grid average).

caveats: Scenario-based estimation only — not provider measurements and not audited carbon accounting.
Token counts are heuristics, not exact tokenizer counts.
All calculations run client-side; no data is sent to any server.
